results.name: Dumbbell Skullcrusher
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet firmly planted and hold a dumbbell in each hand above your chest using a neutral grip.
Keep your upper arms fixed, then bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Extend your elbows to raise the dumbbells along the same path until your arms are straight.
Repeat for the required amount of repetitions.
tips: Keep your elbows pointing upward instead of allowing them to flare outward.
Maintain contact between your head, upper back, hips, and the bench.
Hold your upper arms steady and move only through your elbows.
Inhale as you lower the dumbbells and exhale as you extend your elbows.
results.description: Dumbbell Skullcrusher is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Forearms, Chest.

results.name: Floor Tricep Dip
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your heels planted in front of you with your toes pointing upward. Place both hands behind your hips with your palms flat, your fingers pointing toward your feet, and your elbows slightly bent.
Press through your palms and heels to lift your hips slightly above the floor, keeping your chest raised and your shoulders pulled back.
Press firmly through your palms and extend your elbows to lift your hips. Pause at the top, while squeezing your triceps.
Bend your elbows and lower your hips, returning to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Point your elbows backward instead of allowing them to flare outward.
Move through your elbows rather than dropping and raising your hips alone.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid shrugging them toward your ears.
Inhale as you lower your hips and exhale as you press upward.
results.description: Floor Tricep Dip is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Chest, Forearms.

results.name: Kettlebell Decline Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. Lift your hips and hold a kettlebell above your chest with both hands using a neutral grip.
Keep your hips raised as you bend your elbows and lower the kettlebell toward your forehead, stopping just above it with control.
Extend your elbows and raise the kettlebell back above your chest.
Repeat the movement while maintaining the bridge position, for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain your hips in a raised and level position.
Keep your elbows close together as you lower the weight.
Avoid arching your lower back as you hold the bridge.
Inhale as you lower the kettlebell and exhale as you extend your elbows.
results.description: Kettlebell Decline Skull Crusher is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Forearms, Glutes.

results.name: Kettlebell Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell by the horns above your chest with straight arms.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows to lower the kettlebell toward your forehead.
Extend your elbows to return and repeat.
tips: Point your elbows to the ceiling.
Lower slowly.
results.description: Kettlebell Skull Crusher is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Kettlebell Standing Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell by the horns overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your head.
Lower the kettlebell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms to lift it back up and repeat.
tips: Brace your core to avoid arching your back.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
results.description: Kettlebell Standing Tricep Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core.

results.name: Landmine Lying Tricep Extension
instructions: Lie on your back with your head near the landmine and hold the end of the bar above your face with both hands.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms to press it back up and repeat.
tips: Keep your elbows pointing up.
Control the lowering.
results.description: Landmine Lying Tricep Extension is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Plate Curl to Overhead Press to Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand holding a weight plate in front of your thighs.
Curl it up to your chest, then press it overhead.
Bend your elbows to lower it behind your head, then extend your arms.
Lower the plate back to your chest and thighs and repeat.
tips: Do each phase under control.
Keep your core braced overhead.
results.description: Plate Curl to Overhead Press to Tricep Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Forearms.

results.name: Plate Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand or sit holding a weight plate overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms by your ears.
Lower the plate behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms to return and repeat.
tips: Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Brace your core.
results.description: Plate Overhead Tricep Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Triceps Extension
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about waist height. Stand facing the handles, holding the handles with an overhand grip (palms facing down), and lean forward slightly with your upper arms perpendicular to your torso.
Keep your arms bent at 90 degrees. Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Extend your arms by pressing through your hands until your elbows are fully straight.
Slowly bend your elbows to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you extend your arms and inhale as you bend your elbows.
Focus on using your triceps to perform the extension, avoiding excessive use of your chest, shoulders or back.
Keep your upper arms close to your head and avoid flaring them out to the sides.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Triceps Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back.

results.name: Tricep Cable Kickback on Crossover Machine
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart, and set the cable at a low position. Hold the cable end in one hand and bend slightly forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Position your upper arm parallel to the floor with your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle, keeping your elbow close to your side.
Extend your arm backward by straightening your elbow, keeping your upper arm stationary, and only moving your forearm.
Slowly return to the starting position by bending your elbow. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
tips: Focus on using your triceps to perform the extension, avoiding excessive use of your shoulders or back.
Keep your upper arm stationary throughout the exercise to ensure proper form.
Use a weight that allows you to maintain control and proper form throughout the exercise.
results.description: Tricep Cable Kickback on Crossover Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Forearms.
